subject: Supply chain evidence request: SBOM, subprocessor mapping, and SOC2 addendum
messages:
From: Alex Brody <alex.brody@medicorps.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SBOM and subprocessor mapping for upcoming audit

Marissa —

Thanks for the demo last week. Our security and procurement teams are running a quick vendor review ahead of our Q4 pilot. Two immediate asks from our side so we can close the initial risk assessment:

1) A Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) or dependency list for the runtime components you ship in the hosted product (or guidance on where to find an SBOM for on-prem).
2) A current subprocessor mapping that lists third parties, what data they can access (tokens, telemetry, user data), and whether they are covered by Redwood's SOC 2 or equivalent.

We will also send a SIG questionnaire but wanted to know if you can provide the above by EOD Friday (2026-06-18). If you have an SOC 2 addendum you can sign (to allow our hosted integration), that would accelerate procurement.

Best,
Alex
Alex Brody
Sr. InfoSec Program Manager, Medicorps

---
(Please direct technical artifacts to security-team@medicorps.com)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: alex.brody@medicorps.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-15T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SBOM and subprocessor mapping for upcoming audit

Alex —

Appreciate the heads up and the clear asks. We can provide:
- an SBOM export for the hosted runtime (attached CSV)
- a subprocessor matrix that maps vendor -> data access, location, and compliance status (attached XLSX)
- a signed SOC 2 addendum (we can circulate a DocuSign link once legal signs off)

I’m looping in Rishi from our security team for the technical evidence and Hannah from GTM for any contractual or procurement nuances.

Timeline: I’ll send the initial artifacts today (SBOM + subprocessor matrix). We expect SOC 2 addendum to be signed and returned within 48 hours subject to legal review. If Medicorps needs the SIG/CAIQ pre-populated, we can prioritize that too — would you prefer the SIG or CAIQ format first?

Attachments: redwood_sbom_20260615.csv, subprocessors_matrix_v3.xlsx (early draft)

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales – Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment notes: CSV contains package name, version, license, and origin. XLSX contains vendor, service type, data access columns and SOC2 status (partial).

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, alex.brody@medicorps.com
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-15T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SBOM and subprocessor mapping for upcoming audit

Alex / Marissa —

Adding technical detail from the security side:

1) SBOM: attached is our exported SBOM (redwood_sbom_20260615.csv). It contains runtime libs and native dependencies used in the hosted runtime container. For on-prem deployments we can provide build manifests per release.

2) Subprocessors: the attached matrix lists all subprocessors we currently use in production. Column headings include: vendor, service, region, type of data accessible (tokens/metadata/telemetry), SOC2 coverage, contract flow-down (yes/no), and retention policy link. For any vendor marked as "transient telemetry" we do not store PII.

3) Encryption / KMS: We use AES-256 at rest and TLS1.3 in transit. KMS provider is AWS KMS for hosted; for Dedicated/Private deployments customers can bring their own KMS.

4) SOC 2 addendum: Legal is preparing the addendum. I will provide a DocuSign link when ready.

5) SIG/CAIQ: We can pre-fill the SIG Lite and provide evidence artifacts (network diagrams, patch schedules, runbooks). If SupplyChainQSA needs the SBOM in SPDX format we can export that as well — please confirm format.

Link to internal evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bSbomExample

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security Engineering, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

---
Attachments: redwood_sbom_20260615.csv (SBOM export)

From: security-team@medicorps.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-16T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SBOM and subprocessor mapping for upcoming audit

Thanks for the quick responses and the artifacts. A few clarifications before we can move to the assessor:

- Please confirm whether any subprocessors have access to raw prompt content or unredacted customer-provided data. If yes, list which vendors and controls in place.
- For the top three infrastructure vendors listed (cloud provider, CDN, logging), can you provide SOC 2 coverage dates and whether Redwood is in scope for their subservice organization reports?
- We need evidence of encryption-in-transit (pcap or cipher suite report) and KMS key rotation policy (redacted if necessary).
- Medicorps requires a signed SOC 2 addendum that specifies data segregation and breach notification timelines.

Also our external QSA (SupplyChainQSA Inc.) would like a SBOM in SPDX v2.2 if possible. Can you complete that by Thursday (2026-06-18)?

If you can confirm the items above and upload the requested evidence to the shared Drive folder we’ll route to procurement for a quick PO.

Regards,
Medicorps Security Team
security-team@medicorps.com

---
Note: please send the signed addendum link to procurement@medicorps.com as well.

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: security-team@medicorps.com, alex.brody@medicorps.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-16T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SBOM and subprocessor mapping for upcoming audit

Quick update and plan:

- We confirmed that no subprocessors have access to raw prompt content for the hosted API path; transient telemetry processors only receive redacted telemetry by default. I have added a vetted column in subprocessors_matrix_v3.xlsx clarifying access levels.
- SOC 2 coverage dates for our top infra vendors are included in the XLSX; where we are in-scope for their reports is flagged with links to their SOC reports where available.
- Rishi will upload a TLS cipher-suite summary and our KMS rotation policy to the Drive folder by EOD.
- Legal (Neha) is reviewing the SOC 2 addendum and will circulate the DocuSign link for signature.

We’ve attached the latest matrix (subprocessors_matrix_v3.xlsx). I’ll follow up with the SPDX export of the SBOM once Rishi confirms compatibility.

HubSpot record for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/Medicorps

Thanks — aiming to have all items in Drive for your QSA by 2026-06-18.

Best,
Marissa
